unresolved_gaps: A weak first-month share for Fable does not establish broad commercial failure across premium products.
The available monthly snapshot does not establish sustained demand or failure.
No consistent premium-product boundary or commercial-failure threshold is specified.
Ramp's model-level sample skews toward technology businesses.
